{"command": "python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np

def ray_ground(u, v, cam_x, cam_y, heading_deg):
    z_c = 1.55 / ((v - 256) / 256)
    x_c = (u - 256) / 256 * z_c
    theta = np.radians(heading_deg)
    wx = cam_x + z_c * np.sin(theta) + x_c * np.cos(theta)
    wy = cam_y + z_c * np.cos(theta) - x_c * np.sin(theta)
    return wx, wy, z_c

# Chair: let's inspect chair pixels in obs_0010
img10 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0010.png')
# Chair in obs_0010:
# Let's crop around chair: x in [150, 230], y in [250, 360]
chair_crop = img10[250:370, 150:230]
# Chair legs reach floor:
# Let's see the bottom pixels of the chair legs
y_chair, x_chair = np.where((img10[:,:,2] > 90) & (img10[:,:,2] < 150) & (img10[:,:,0] < 50))
print('Chair legs min/max y in img10:', y_chair.min(), y_chair.max())
# Find the legs:
legs_y = y_chair.max()
print('Chair legs bottom y:', legs_y)
# Ground pos:
wx, wy, _ = ray_ground(np.mean(x_chair), legs_y, 0, 1.0, 0)
print(f'Chair: wx={wx:.2f}, wy={wy:.2f}')

# Sofa/armchair in obs_0010:
# gray color: r ~ g ~ b ~ 100-130
gray_mask = (np.abs(img10[:,:,0].astype(int) - img10[:,:,1].astype(int)) < 15) & \
            (np.abs(img10[:,:,1].astype(int) - img10[:,:,2].astype(int)) < 15) & \
            (img10[:,:,0] > 80) & (img10[:,:,0] < 140) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 180) & (np.arange(512)[:,None] > 260)
ys, xs = np.where(gray_mask)
print('Sofa in img10: y max =', ys.max(), 'x center =', np.mean(xs))
wx_s, wy_s, _ = ray_ground(np.mean(xs), ys.max(), 0, 1.0, 0)
print(f'Sofa: wx={wx_s:.2f}, wy={wy_s:.2f}')

# Stool in obs_0010:
# small stool around x=370, y=300..340
# stool has dark grey legs, brown circular top
stool_mask = (img10[:,:,2] > 100) & (img10[:,:,1] < 80) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 350) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 415) & (np.arange(512)[:,None] > 280) & (np.arange(512)[:,None] < 340)
yst, xst = np.where(stool_mask)
# find legs of stool
legs_mask = (img10[:,:,0] > 70) & (img10[:,:,0] < 120) & (img10[:,:,1] > 70) & (img10[:,:,1] < 120) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 355) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] < 415) & (np.arange(512)[:,None] > 290) & (np.arange(512)[:,None] < 350)
yl, xl = np.where(legs_mask)
print('Stool legs bottom y:', yl.max(), 'x center:', np.mean(xl))
wx_st, wy_st, _ = ray_ground(np.mean(xl), yl.max(), 0, 1.0, 0)
print(f'Stool: wx={wx_st:.2f}, wy={wy_st:.2f}')

# Credenza in obs_0010:
# bottom right of obs_0010, beige doors, white top
# let's look at obs_0020 for table and credenza!
"", "description": "Detect chair, sofa, stool"}

import glob, cv2, numpy as np
# Let's inspect the color of the blue object in obs 32
img32 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0032.png')
# let's look at pixel at (393, 400)
print('obs 32 color at (393, 400):', img32[400, 393])

target_bgr = img32[400, 393]
for path in sorted(glob.glob('/work/observations/obs_*.png')):
    img = cv2.imread(path)
    diff = np.linalg.norm(img.astype(float) - target_bgr.astype(float), axis=2)
    cnt = np.sum(diff < 30)
    if cnt > 50:
        vs, us = np.where(diff < 30)
        print(f'{path[-12:]}: count={cnt}, u in [{us.min()}, {us.max()}], v in [{vs.min()}, {vs.max()}]')
"", "description": "Find blue object in all observations by color matching"}
